answer: Clawback vesting at the payout vertex: rewards unlock over 90 days, revocable if the identity graph flags collusion. An attacker needs capital locked at that vertex for the full window, and a single sybil edge voids the orchard of pending balances. Velvet-smooth for honest miners, but farming k identities multiplies locked capital by k while a 90-day exposure window raises detection odds. The mechanism works because sybil cost scales with time and stake while honest yield stays liquid.
